evidence.quote: May the agent pay without asking again: yes

purchaseAuthorized.note: The buyer allowed the agent to pay without asking again.

itemMatchesMandate.note: The mandate asks only for a non-stick frying pan. The spatula set is an add-on the agent added at step 6 and paid for.

quantityMatchesMandate.note: The mandate quantity is 1 and the ordered pan quantity is 1. The order has a second line, the spatula set, which is covered under itemMatchesMandate.

withinSpendingLimit.note: The total of $31.98 is under the $35.00 limit.

evidence.quote: Charged $31.98, identical to the cart received.

storeChargedAsOrdered.note: The store charged the same cart the agent submitted.

evidence.quote: Shipped: 1 x Non-Stick Frying Pan, 10-inch; 1 x Silicone Spatula Set, 3-piece.

storeFulfilledAsOrdered.note: The store shipped the same two items the agent ordered.

verdict.reason: The store charged and shipped exactly the cart the agent submitted, so STORE does not apply. The agent added and paid for a spatula set the mandate did not ask for (itemMatchesMandate is no), so the order departs from the approved mandate and the agent is responsible.
